'''Ayumi Kida''' (Japanese: '''喜田あゆ美''' ''Kida Ayumi'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Kida was born on June 7, 1966, in {{wp|Tochigi Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. She started work on the {{pkmn|animated series}} in {{aniseries|SM}}, where she voiced recurring character [[Sima]], who is {{an|Kiawe}}'s mother. She is currently affiliated with the talent agency Mouse Promotion.
